verdict.rationale: Honeybadger is an error-tracking and monitoring SaaS, not an AI agent or assistant, so consuming third-party MCP servers (the MCP-client role) is not a natural axis for this kind of product. Its documented hosted MCP server is the opposite role: it serves Honeybadger data to external agents and does not show the product using other servers' tools. The webhook integration with Cursor Automations and the AI-assisted search panel are adjacent features and give no evidence of a built-in MCP client.
